apiTokens.title: API tokens
apiTokens.subtitle: Policy-scoped tokens for programmatic access.
apiTokens.rotateDesc: A new secret is generated and shown once. Choose how the current secret is retired.
apiTokens.graceDesc: Recommended. Gives integrations a day to switch over.
apiTokens.nowDesc: The current secret stops working at once.
apiTokens.deleteDescSuffix: will stop working immediately and can't be recovered.
apiTokens.revealDesc: This is the only time “{{name}}”’s secret is shown. Store it securely — you can't retrieve it later.
apiTokens.lifetimeHintMonthly: Auto-rotates every 30 days (24h grace). Admins are emailed 24h before — rotate manually then to capture the new secret.
apiTokens.lifetimeHintForever: Never auto-rotates. Rotate manually whenever you need to.
apiTokens.policiesEmpty: No policies — this token can't access anything. Add at least one.
apiTokens.policiesHint: Each row grants an action on a resource. “All resources” (*) and action “all” are wildcards.
